t.Which surah comes first in the Quran?: Ni sura gani inayokuja kwanza katika Qur'ani?
t.Which surah comes last in the Quran?: Ni sura gani inayokuja mwisho katika Qur'ani?
t.Which surah do we recite in every rak'ah: Ni sura gani tunayoisoma katika kila rakaa?
t.Which surah ends with many names of Alla: Ni sura gani inayomalizika kwa majina mengi ya Allah: Al-Malik, Al-Quddus, As-Salam...?
t.Which two names come together at the sta: Ni majina gani mawili yanayokuja pamoja mwanzoni mwa Ayat al-Kursi?
t.While he was standing in prayer, the goo: Alipokuwa amesimama katika sala, ilikuja habari njema: Allah angempa mvulana aitwaye Yahya, jina ambalo Allah hakuwahi kumpa mtu yeyote kabla.
t.Who built the House (Kaaba) with Ibrahim: Nani alijenga Nyumba (Al-Ka'ba) pamoja na Nabii Ibrahim?
t.Who comforted the Prophet ﷺ after the fi: Nani alimtuliza Mtume ﷺ baada ya wahyi wa kwanza?
t.Who is the last of the prophets?: Nani ni wa mwisho wa Mitume?
t.Who saw eleven stars, the sun and the mo: Nani aliona nyota kumi na moja, jua na mwezi katika ndoto?
t.Whoever believes in Allah and the Last D: Anayemwamini Allah na Siku ya Mwisho aseme jema au anyamaze.
t.Whom did Musa ask Allah to make his help: Nabii Musa alimwomba Allah amfanye nani kuwa msaidizi wake?
Paka maji juu ya kichwa chako kwa mikono iliyolowa.
t.Years later he returned and entered Makk: Miaka kadhaa baadaye alirudi na akaingia Makka siku ya Ukombozi (Al-Fath). Msaada wa Allah na ushindi ulikuja.
Ndiyo, Uislamu umejengwa juu ya nguzo tano.
t.Yes, even his people knew he was truthfu: Ndiyo, hata watu wake walijua kwamba ni mkweli.
Ndiyo, kwa hiyo tunagawana chakula chetu.
t.Yes. Being kind to animals brings reward: Ndiyo. Kuwahurumia wanyama huleta malipo mema.
t.Yes: Say Bismillah and eat with your rig: Ndiyo: Sema Bismillah na ule kwa mkono wako wa kulia.
Ndiyo: Sema, Yeye ni Allah, Mmoja.
t.Young Yusuf saw a dream: eleven stars, t: Nabii Yusuf akiwa mdogo aliota ndoto: nyota kumi na moja, jua na mwezi vikimsujudia. Alimweleza baba yake Nabii Yakubu.
t.Your friend sneezes and says Alhamdulill: Rafiki yako anapiga chafya na kusema Alhamdulillah. Wewe unasema nini?
t.Your mother, then your mother, then your: Mama yako, kisha mama yako, kisha mama yako
t.Yunus left his people and boarded a ship: Nabii Yunus aliwaacha watu wake na akapanda jahazi lililokuwa limejaa.
t.Yunus was brought out onto the shore, an: Nabii Yunus alitolewa ufukweni, na Allah akaotesha mmea juu yake.
t.Zakariya had grown old and his wife had: Nabii Zakaria alikuwa amezeeka na mkewe hakuwa na watoto. Alimwomba Mola wake kwa sauti ya chini: Mola wangu, nipe kutoka Kwako mtoto mwema. Wewe unasikia kila dua.
t.Zakariya took care of Maryam. Whenever h: Nabii Zakaria alimtunza Maryam. Kila alipoingia katika chumba chake cha ibada, alikuta chakula kwake. Aliuliza: Hiki kimetoka wapi? Akasema: Kimetoka kwa Allah. Allah humruzuku amtakaye bila hesabu.
t.Zakariya wondered how this could be, and: Nabii Zakaria alishangaa jinsi hilo lingewezekana, na Allah akasema: Ni jambo jepesi Kwangu. Kama ishara, Nabii Zakaria hakuzungumza na watu kwa masiku matatu isipokuwa kwa ishara, na akawaambia wamtukuze Allah asubuhi na jioni.
